content_text: I’m not Roger, but I just can’t hold back on this topic; in my opinion HDR does more harm than good aesthetically, especially on films. There certainly are people that enjoy it but I think the demand for HDR was created by the industry first, not the audience, just like with 4K or 3D TV’s.
